typography._ruling: Pass-101, WINNING-BRIEF-2026-09-05 §2 and §16.4 (operator, 2026-09-06: 'Well arent you going to build the other pages in this style?'). The Room and Ledger system: Anybody is the display AND label face, Hanken Grotesk is the text face, and there is NO mono. The retired mono face and Bricolage, Instrument Serif/Sans, Inter, Space Grotesk, Syne, Unbounded are banned in this direction. Bricolage remains loaded, unpreloaded, only until phase 3 ports the last unrestyled route.

label.setting: 14px, wdth 80, uppercase, letter-spacing .04em, line-height 1.45, ink at 60% (100% when current)

signature.description: Case-study hero title: 96px Inter Display 700+ pinned vertical word stack, GSAP scroll-resolve to caption + first still cross-fade. ~600ms hold.

view_transition.description: 600ms ease-in-out cross-fade between cream paper and theater ground on foyer↔theater navigation. Reduced-motion kill-switch in app/globals.css.

figure.description: The book's page-6 figure drawn once on load in the /playbook hero: dashed context-window line wiped in, saffron unwritten-rules line climbing on an ease-in-quad, an 80ms hold at the crossing while the marker stamps, then a break-through on ease-out. ~1.26s of visible motion, CSS only, no loop, no scroll or input coupling. Approved in writing by the motion-engineer 2026-09-01 as a FIGURE animation, NOT a second signature interaction: it is the artifact playing, not the site responding to the visitor. Granted an explicit exception to the R15 400ms entrance cap on that basis. Base CSS is the finished frame; motion applies only at >=900px with no reduced-motion preference. Scoped to /playbook.

room_and_ledger._ruling: WINNING-BRIEF-2026-09-05 §16.3, operator 2026-09-06 verbatim: 'Lack of animations and weak ones that exist. FYI I love website animations need more'. The corpus's one-moment discipline is OVERRULED BY THE CLIENT on the Room and Ledger surfaces. The vocabulary is not relaxed: transform/opacity/clip-path only, the house curve cubic-bezier(.4,0,0,1), nothing coupled to the cursor, no scroll-jack, no marquee, no parallax on photographs, at most 3 @keyframes site-wide, and every rest state is the finished frame — a page with scripting off shows everything.
set: 1. THE MOMENT: the copper word lights when the fingertip arrives — opacity .28 filling to 1 over 260ms, triggered by the clip's timeupdate at the arrival time; 'I build the' rises 24px over 600ms. Once lit it stays lit.
2. The bar slides down 12px and fades in at the seam (240ms), never again.
3. Section heads: clip-path reveal from the left, inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0), 700ms, once each as the head crosses the reading line.
4. Hairlines draw: every ledger rule scaleX(0 to 1) from the left, 500ms, 60ms stagger within a section.
5. Cards and blocks rise: price cards 20px with a 70ms stagger, then Engagements, then objection columns; media and the cover rise 10px. 500ms, once.
6. Operator: the square's film settles from scale(1.06) to 1 over 1.2s as it enters; the two heading rows rise 20px, 80ms apart.
7. Hovers: chips swap ground in 300ms; every arrow slides 6px right on hover/focus (200ms); the receipt rows' copper wipe; price-card borders turn copper (300ms).
8. The ask: the copper field's headline rises 30px and the arrow slides in from the left (600ms); the chips follow 120ms later.
9. The ground travel and the rail-style lighting.
All nine on the home; items 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 on every other page. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables all of it and shows finished frames.

tokens.max_entrance_ms_note: Raised from 300 for Room and Ledger surfaces ONLY, by the §16.3 ruling. The longest member of the set is item 6's 1.2s film settle. motion-token-lint.sh still hardcodes 300; until it reads this value, a line over the cap carries the hook's own documented escape hatch — '/* motion-ok: §16.3-N, <reason> */' — which is an opt-out the gate defines, not a bypass. Outside these surfaces the 300ms cap stands.
